description: Successful repair strategies that resolved known failure patterns. Each entry maps a failure pattern ID to the constraint change that converged it.

patterns.name: update_denominator_api_catalog_hash
patterns.description: When the pipeline reports catalog hash mismatch, compute the current run's catalog hash and update api_catalog_sha256 in the denominator file.

denominator_change.how_to_compute: Run pipeline once; hash is logged as 'current hash' in scenario planner output

patterns.verification: Re-run immediately after denominator update; catalog hash check must pass before scenario planning proceeds

patterns.name: add_required_using_text_namespace
patterns.description: Add REQUIRED constraint for 'using Aspose.Pdf.Text;' to all PDF types that use TextFragment in fixture creation.

constraint_change.constraint_text: REQUIRED: using Aspose.Pdf.Text; (for TextFragment fixture creation)

patterns.verification: Generated code must contain 'using Aspose.Pdf.Text;' above the class definition; validator checks this

patterns.name: add_forbidden_datasources_subnamespace
patterns.description: Add FORBIDDEN constraint for the hallucinated sub-namespace Aspose.Pdf.LowCode.DataSources.

constraint_change.constraint_text: FORBIDDEN: using Aspose.Pdf.LowCode.DataSources — sub-namespace does not exist

patterns.verification: Validator must scan generated code for 'LowCode.DataSources' and fail if found

patterns.name: add_required_concrete_options_class_pdfa
patterns.description: Add REQUIRED constraint naming the concrete options class PdfAConvertOptions and FORBIDDEN constraints blocking generic alternatives.

required: REQUIRED: new PdfAConvertOptions( — use PdfAConvertOptions as the concrete options class (NOT PluginOptions)
forbidden: FORBIDDEN: new PluginOptions() — PluginOptions is abstract, use PdfAConvertOptions
FORBIDDEN: LowCodeLoadOptions — wrong options class for PdfAConverter
FORBIDDEN: LowCodeSaveOptions — wrong options class for PdfAConverter

patterns.verification: Validator checks for 'PdfAConvertOptions' presence and absence of PluginOptions/LowCodeLoadOptions/LowCodeSaveOptions

patterns.name: add_required_structural_merger_constraints
patterns.description: Promote all critical structural patterns for Merger to REQUIRED so they survive repair prompt re-injection.

required: REQUIRED: new MergeOptions() — use MergeOptions as the concrete options class
REQUIRED: options.AddInput(new FileDataSource( — add all input files via AddInput
REQUIRED: options.AddOutput(new FileDataSource( — set output file via AddOutput
REQUIRED: new Merger().Process(options) — call Process on instance
constraint_change.rationale: Repair prompt re-injects ALL REQUIRED: constraints. If structural patterns are only in template_hints, they are lost during repair.

patterns.verification: Post-repair code must still contain AddInput, AddOutput, MergeOptions, and Merger().Process()

patterns.name: add_required_text_namespace_splitter
patterns.description: Add REQUIRED: using Aspose.Pdf.Text; to Splitter because LLM non-deterministically uses TextFragment in fixture creation.

constraint_change.constraint_text: REQUIRED: using Aspose.Pdf.Text; (for TextFragment fixture creation)
constraint_change.rationale: Even if a run does not use TextFragment, having this as REQUIRED does not break builds. It prevents the non-deterministic failure when LLM does choose TextFragment.

patterns.verification: Runs with and without TextFragment in fixture both pass; validator accepts either path

patterns.name: simplify_required_constraint_token
patterns.description: Reformulate REQUIRED constraints to use simple, unambiguous first tokens that the LLM will include verbatim.

constraint_change.before: REQUIRED: template DOCX created with MERGEFIELD fields via DocumentBuilder.InsertField("MERGEFIELD FieldName")
constraint_change.after: REQUIRED: InsertField("MERGEFIELD — create MERGEFIELD fields in template via DocumentBuilder.InsertField
constraint_change.principle: The constraint validation extracts the token before the first '(' — so the token must be the actual method/identifier the LLM must include. Complex strings with quoted arguments confuse the extraction.

patterns.verification: Generated code contains 'InsertField' with MERGEFIELD argument; constraint extraction yields 'InsertField' token which is present

patterns.name: remove_processor_from_allowed_types
patterns.description: Remove Processor from allowed_types because the API access paradox cannot be resolved at the pipeline level.

config_change.backlog_reason: API_ACCESS_PARADOX: constructors:[] + all instance methods = CS0120+CS1729. Requires ProcessorContext factory investigation or Aspose.Words version upgrade.

patterns.verification: pipeline/configs/families/words.yml allowed_types does NOT include Processor; words backlog includes Processor entry with API_ACCESS_PARADOX reason

patterns.name: add_forbidden_generic_options_pdfa
patterns.description: Already captured in RP-004. Documented here for cross-reference: adding FORBIDDEN for LowCodeLoadOptions and LowCodeSaveOptions prevents the hallucination of generic containers as PdfAConverter options.

forbidden: FORBIDDEN: LowCodeLoadOptions — wrong options class for PdfAConverter, use PdfAConvertOptions
FORBIDDEN: LowCodeSaveOptions — wrong options class for PdfAConverter, use PdfAConvertOptions

patterns.verification: Validator must scan for 'LowCodeLoadOptions' and 'LowCodeSaveOptions' and fail if found in PdfAConverter examples

meta_principles.principle: Repair prompt re-injection scope determines what survives repair
meta_principles.detail: Only REQUIRED: and FORBIDDEN: labeled constraints are re-injected into repair prompts. Template hints, comments, and inline guidance are NOT re-injected. Any pattern that must survive repair must be a REQUIRED: constraint.

meta_principles.principle: Constraint tokens must be simple and unambiguous
meta_principles.detail: Constraint validation extracts the token before the first '(' or first whitespace. Long constraints with quoted strings cause extraction failures. Keep the primary identifier as the first token.

meta_principles.principle: Concrete options class names must be explicit for all PDF LowCode types
meta_principles.detail: LLM cannot infer concrete options class names from type names alone. For every new PDF LowCode type added to allowed_types, add REQUIRED: constraint naming the concrete options class (e.g., MergeOptions, SplitOptions, OptimizeOptions, TextExtractorOptions, PdfAConvertOptions).

meta_principles.principle: Non-runnable types with API access paradox must be excluded early
meta_principles.detail: Types with constructors:[] and all instance methods are structurally unreachable. Detect this pattern in the catalog before adding to allowed_types. Check: constructors array length == 0 AND no is_static:true methods.

meta_principles.principle: Non-deterministic fixture patterns require defensive constraints
meta_principles.detail: If an LLM sometimes uses a non-LowCode type in fixture creation (e.g., TextFragment for PDF Splitter), add the required using directive as REQUIRED even for runs that do not need it. The cost of an extra using directive is zero; the cost of a non-deterministic failure is a full re-run.
